metaTitle: Hanun Bu Lebḥer — Tirzi ɣer Lɣerb n Tafrikt
metaDesc: Hanun Bu Lebḥer, anmhal aqarṭaǧi n lebḥer: 60 n lbabuṛen, 30 000 n yimezdaɣ imaynuten, Timyatiryun, Kerne, « Takeṛṛust n Yilluten » akked « igurilliyen ». Tirzi d idiwenniyen ɣef ubrid-is.
heroCap: Lkanu aqdim s tɣenjawin d tfeluct
title: Hanun Bu Lebḥer
epithet: « Agellid n Iqarṭaǧiyen » akken i d-tenna Tirzi — ahat d asufeṭ neɣ d umaẓan n temdint.
lede: Yettwazen sɣur Qarṭaǧ ɣer deffir n Tigejda n Hercule, iḍfeṛ rrif n Agaraw Aṭlanti n Tafrikt akken ad yesers tudrin din. Taqsiṭ-is, Tirzi, d ccahada taqburt n unadi n Lɣerb n Tafrikt.
stats.0.t: n lbabuṛen s xemsin n tɣenjawin
stats.1.t: n yergazen d tlawin, akken i d-tenna Tirzi
stats.2.t: n tudrin yettwasersen ɣef rrif n Agaraw Aṭlanti

openQuote: Yehwa i Iqarṭaǧiyen ad iṛuḥ Hanun ɣer deffir n Tigejda n Hercule, ad yesers tudrin n Libufinisiyen. Iṛuḥ ihi s sețțin n lbabuṛen akked waṭas n yergazen d tlawin, ɣer tlatin alef, akked lqut d wayen akk i gesra.
textParas.0: Tirzi tewweḏ-aɣ-d s tgrikt, deg yiwet n tira-ɣuṛes tabizanṭit n leqṛun wis 9, yettwaḥerzen di Heidelberg. Tettbeyyen iman-is d tasuqilt n tira tapunikt i gessers Hanun, asmi yuɣal-d, deg umqam n Kronos — yeɛni Baɛal Hammun — di Qarṭaǧ.
textParas.1: Awezlan (18 n tegzumin), iqqaṛ akken ilaq am tezmilt n lbabuṛ, ikemmel ussan n tira ɣef lebḥer, isemma imukan. D yiwen seg idrisen iqarṭaǧiyen idrusen aṭas i d-yeqqimen, xersum s ubrid aggur.
textParas.2: Azemz n tirzi ur yettwassen ara s ṣṣeḥ: tettusers s telqey ger aqeṛn wis 6 d wis 5 uqbel Ɛisa, deg wakud i deg Qarṭaǧ tesnas ssbek-is n yiswaq n Agaraw Aṭlanti.
voyTitle: Ɣer deffir n Tigejda n Hercule
steps.0.v: Asutel yeffeg seg Qarṭaǧ, iḍfeṛ rrif n Ugafa n Tafrikt, izger tabuɣezt n Gibraltar — Tigejda n Hercule.
steps.1.v: Sin wussan seld tbuɣezt, tamdint tamezwarut tettwasers, ɣer rrif n uzaɣaṛ ameqqran.
steps.2.v: Aẖali yeffren s tgemmunin; din bennun amqam i Pusidun.
steps.3.v: Deffir n ugelmam ideg llan ilfan, ttwasersent Karikun Teicus, Gitte, Akra, Melitta akked Arambis.
steps.4.v: Ɣef wasif-agi ameqqran, tiddukla akked At Lixus, imeksawen itlellen, i d-yefkan imsalayen.
steps.5.v: Tagzirt tamecṭuḥt deg tagna, anida ttwasersen imezdaɣ imaynuten: tettuɣal d ssas n tirzi. Hanun iḥseb belli tebɛed seg Tigejda am wakken tebɛed Tigejda seg Qarṭaǧ.
steps.6.v: Asif yeččuṛ d yiqṭiwen akked yimaẓẓuɣen n lebḥer; irgazen lsan iɣelman nnekkaren i yimsebrayen s wezṛu.
steps.7.v: Deg yiḏ, aẖali yettwassen s times; sellen i tɣenjawin, ttzuran d iɣiḍen. Iweɛẕalen fkan lameṛ ad rewlen.
steps.8.v: Adrar aɛlayan deg tmes, tiɣuraf-is ẖilent ad ḥeḍḍnent s yitran: Theon Ochema, « Takeṛṛust n Yilluten ».
steps.9.v: Deg tegzirt n tagna-agi zedɣent « tigurilliyen ». Lexsas n lqut, asutel yettuɣal ɣer deffir.
steps.10.v: Di Qarṭaǧ, taqsiṭ tettwaseṭṭaṛ deg umqam n Baɛal Hammun.
mapText: Tirzigin n Elisa, Hanun d Himilkun. Seld Lmerruk, abrid n Hanun yeqqim d tiktit kan.
wonders.0.title: Tudrin n Libufinisiyen
wonders.0.text: Tlatin alef n yergazen d tlawin: mačči d ahuzi, d tawuri n users n yimezdaɣ. Tudrin timaynutin, zedɣent-tent Iqarṭaǧiyen d Ifriqiyen, ssersent abrid n Agaraw Aṭlanti.
wonders.1.title: Ilfan, iqṭiwen, imaẓẓuɣen n lebḥer
wonders.1.text: Tirzi tbeyyen-d agelmam anida ttirarent ilfan, sakin asif yeččuṛ d yiqṭiwen akked yimaẓẓuɣen n lebḥer — yettuɛawaden aṭas ɣer wasif n Senegal.
wonders.2.title: « Takeṛṛust n Yilluten »
wonders.2.text: Adrar n tmes i d-yettban seg lebḥer. Llan wid i d-yeẓran adrar n Kamirun, abeṛkan ur yefsi ara iɛedda 4 000 n yimitren; wiyaḏ ḥesben-tt d times n lexla ɣef yidurar n rrif.
shipAlt: Taɣmart n lbabuṛ apunik n Marsala
shipCap: Lbabuṛ apunik n Marsala, aqeṛn wis 3 uqbel Ɛisa
gorQuote: Llant waṭas n lweḥc; ugar-nsent d tlawin s lǧeld yeččuṛen d ucebbub, i gesawalen imsalayen-nneɣ igurilliyen. Ur nezmir ara ad neṭṭef irgazen; neṭṭef tlata n tlawin, i gettqerrifen tettɛeḏḏant… Neɣ-itent, nawi-d iɣelman-nsent ɣer Qarṭaǧ.
gorText: Ma d izem n lɣaba (chimpanzé), ma d agurilli, ma d ababwin (babouin)? Yiwen ur yessin. Plin Amɣar yeqqar-d dakken iɣelman-agi qqiment d askanen deg umqam n Junun (Tanit) armi d aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ deg 146. Deg 1847, lɛulama n tɣawsiwin n ṭṭbiɛa Savage d Wyman ɛawden-d awal n Tirzi akken ad semmin i uqchuc ameqqran n Tafrikt talemmast: agurilli.
debateLede: Imussnawen n umezruy mgaraden seg leqṛun: tanzagin d ismawen n Tirzi ẕẕayen aṭas n yiwalayen.
debates.0.title: Armi ɣer Kamirun
debates.0.text: Takeṛṛust n Yilluten ad tili d adrar n Kamirun, Aqeṛwi n Usammar d daxel n tagna n Gine, neɣ ula d Gabun. Hanun ad yili yezger ugar n 5 000 n ikilumitren seld tbuɣezt.
debates.1.title: Senegal, Sierra Leone
debates.1.text: Krites ad yili d asif n Senegal, Takeṛṛust n Yilluten d adrar n Kakulima (Gine) akked Aqeṛwi n Usammar d rrif n Sierra Leone. D tiktit i gettwaqeblen aṭas.
debates.2.title: Lmerruk Aṭlanti
debates.2.text: Kra n lɛulama snernin tirzi ala ɣer usammar n Lmerruk (Kerne = tegzirt n Mogador, anida ttwaf-d iswaq n Ifinisiyen) ḥesben-d belli ayen i d-yeqqimen yemɣaṛ-it, neɣ ula yesnulfa-t umsuqel agriki.
legacy.0.v: Plin Amɣar akked Arrian bedren Hanun; Arrian yura-d belli yuɣal ɣer deffir seld 35 n wussan n tira ɣef lebḥer, s lexsas n waman d ssxana tazɣurant. Plin iqeṛṛeb-it ɣer Himilkun, yettwazen ɣer ugafa deg uzemz-nni.
legacy.1.v: Iburtugizen ur zegren ara ẖali Bojador armi 1434: qrib alfin n iseggasen seld-as, inagmaren n Tenhudi ṭṭfen, war ad ẓren, abrid n lbabuṛen iqarṭaǧiyen.
legacy.2.v: Isem « agurilli », i d-yettwakksen seg Tirzi, ikcem ɣer umawal n lɛulama.
legacy.3.v: Tirzi teqqim d taqsiṭ tiddukli n tira iqarṭaǧit i d-yeqqimen iyes, d adris aqbur ɣef idgaren n Lɣerb n Tafrikt.

links.0.text: Imaziɣen, inumidiyen d iberdan ifriqiyen n temdint tapunikt.
links.1.title: Tadamsa tapunikt
links.1.text: Iswaq, lmɛadan d iberdan n lebḥer: ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ.

links.2.text: Iqayden, inagmaren d tgellidin n Qarṭaǧ.
